source: Source-exact BV generator; bounded variation ∫_{(-1,0)} |z| ν(dz) < ∞; exact drift = c - ∫ z ν; strict interior HJB; gradient ≥ 1; continuity at the origin. The source-exact translation identity ∫_0^ε (w(y)-w(y-a)) dy = ∫_{max(0,ε-a)}^ε w(y) dy controls negative jumps by ∫ min(ε,-z) ν(dz), which vanishes as ε↓0. This is the independent analytical zero-benchmark obstruction that removes the entire be711acd branch from the parent, conditional on proving this new child. No original stochastic stopped-grid premise is assumed or replaced.

title: Original zero-jump Lévy finite stopped C² Gaussian source sum is integrable and exactly centred
author: @WillR
source: For the original zero-jump spectrally negative Lévy process and its actual dividend-controlled reserve, a finite family of bounded physical stopping times with localised gradient and Hessian bounds yields a finite sum of true stopped centred first-order and compensated half-variance Gaussian C² Itô cells. The sum is integrable and its expectation is zero. This is a finite-mesh source bridge feeding the positive-clock stopped Gaussian signed budget; coefficient boundedness remains a genuine localisation obligation.

title: Centred genuine original compensated jump sum over a finite physical grid
author: @WillR
source: A genuine original-source finite-grid reduction from the Proved/public clock-increment theorem 0f48f2b4-7448-492d-a72d-733868072f74. The telescoping identity ∑_{i<k}(M(u(i+1))-M(u(i)))=M(u(k))-M(u(0)) identifies the grid sum with an already centred L1 original compensated clock increment. The result can supply the jump-martingale part of the original stopped triple-mesh source, but does not claim identification with its cash/terminal or drift R terms.
